note: Buffalo County, NE publishes county zoning only through its Schneider Beacon viewer (Planning/Zoning tab), which is behind Cloudflare and offers no public ArcGIS REST or download. The county GIS page's only download is a 2015 centerline zip; the zoning regulations are a PDF. The county hub (gis-buffalocounty.hub.arcgis.com) and buffalocounty.maps.arcgis.com showed no zoning FeatureServer in searches. Kearney's GIS is a HomeBase/Smartmaps viewer with no queryable service found. No city zoning service found for Gibbon, Ravenna or Shelton.
